rites.name: Fenostath
rites.text: Fenostath is the concept of a resonant tone that ran through Thivsora during the Singing, when the first roots of the world condensed out of drifting light. It is remembered as the pull that drew scattered matter into the first groves and gave early kingdoms their shape.

rites.name: Tenmaeno
rites.text: Tenmaeno is the concept of a sounding that gathers the first roots of Thivsora into shape during the Singing, when the world first takes form. In the Age of Sundering, its resonance is said to break the old bonds that held landfall together.

rites.name: Sheisora
rites.text: Sheisora is the concept of a chain of stars gathered by the Thivsora priests into a single sacred flame during the Holy Age. It was the thread that held the Pact together when the worlds broke apart in the Sundering. Its shards still drift between the Thivsora orders, each keeping a fragment of the old fire alive.

rites.name: Toruthougok
rites.text: Toruthougok is a concept in Thivsora's Holy Age, bound to the Fall and the Sundering, when worlds broke apart and the Pact was sworn over the Shards. Its temples and orders venerate it as the flame that held the broken stars together during the Pact's making.

rites.name: Vesathith
rites.text: Vesathith is a seismic rite-tool of the Stellar realm's seventh age, a pillar of crystallized starlight that its wardens strike against the crust of dying suns to fracture them into orderly rings. Its first strike sends a deep blue pulse that topples packs of lesser beasts, while its greater form requires a second impact or a flare of plasma to keep the fallen from rising again.

rites.name: Vesathith
rites.text: Vesathith is a dying-star crystal lattice that hums in the void between suns, storing the ambient light of collapsed nebulae within its facets. Ancient navigators mined its shards to forge keys that could unlock sealed gravitational gates, though each shard drains a little of the star it orbits.

rites.name: Zepheivseth
rites.text: Zepheivseth is a drifting shell-fortress of the Thivsora stellar realm, its walls wrapped in a bending lattice of cooled plasma that swallows and turns back starlight. Its seven-age keepers raise and lower the lattice in slow pulses, and the Ashen Choir sings the frequencies that keep the shell from tearing itself apart.

rites.name: Xaavseth
rites.text: Xaavseth is a stellar-scale sentient lattice of dimming plasma that threads through the cores of old suns, using its vantage to read the slow heartbeat of fusion across a whole system. Its inhabitants regard it as a patient observer, a living lens that can focus a star's own light into a single burning beam when a dying world demands judgment.

rites.name: Ashyuvsora
rites.text: Ashyuvsora is a concept-born stellar intelligence of the sixth epoch, a lattice of luminous hinges that shifts between orbits by folding and unfolding its own gravity. Its seventh year marked the first time it deliberately bent a dying sun's corona into a spring to vault across a sector.

rites.name: Xaistis
rites.text: Xaistis is a stellar-era technique that gathers a star's radiant pressure into a single bearing and launches the practitioner along it in a flash of white light. Its masters are said to pass through the afterimages of collapsing suns. The art is taught only to those who can hold still while the star's heat roars around them.

rites.name: Ashivseth
rites.text: Ashivseth is a stellar concept from the seventh age of the Thivsora cosmos, a mirror-sail that turns a starship in a full inverted arc to shake off pursuers. Its maneuver is used so often in the wake of deep-space raids that the ancient fleets named the arc after its inventor. A single crossing of its gravitic wake can burn away a small star's corona.

rites.name: Thyuthess
rites.text: Thyuthess is a stellar concept, the sixth age of the Thivsora omniverse, meant to be a turning maneuver that folds a starship's path back on itself. It is said to lock onto any boundary of its sky and reverse course without a pilot's command.

rites.name: Shesathora
rites.text: Shesathora is a stellar-scale concept of a plasma-sheathed drift engine, a shimmering envelope that a traveler wraps around their body before hurling themselves along a chosen vector. Its wielders are known for surfing gravitational wakes and skimming stellar corona, leaving luminous tails across the dark between suns.

rites.name: Shizith
rites.text: Shizith is a stellar concept of the sixth era, a seven-billion-year-old lattice of ember-woven sails that drift between dying suns and harvest their light. It rides the solar wind as a shared perch, letting smaller navigators cling to its crest while the hull itself becomes a steady, unbreakable platform for their gunfire.

rites.name: Tennaala
rites.text: Tennaala is the concept of shelving: the bare idea by which the Library in Thivsora sorts every branching outcome of the Three Futures into order. In the Holy Age, when temples keep their flames burning and orders guard the sacred lamps, the concept is said to hold the ending still while the futures are weighed.
